Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects. You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to learn more.

jobs.occupation: Become a Reach Truck Operator – Training Included!
jobs.description:
Are you motivated to take on a new challenge and earn an official reach truck certificate? Do you have no previous experience or training as a reach truck operator but are eager to learn? Then we're looking for you! What will you do? For our client in Zeebrugge, we are looking for motivated candidates who want to train as reach truck operators. After successfully passing the selection process, you will receive professional reach truck training. Once you have obtained your certificate, you will immediately start working for our client. Your responsibilities include:
 

 
• Transporting products and pallets using a reach truck, sometimes at heights of up to 10 metres.
 
• Placing and storing goods in the correct warehouse locations.
 
• Contributing to a safe and efficient warehouse operation.
 
• Working closely with your colleagues to ensure smooth day-to-day operations. 

Who are we looking for?
 

 
• You have no previous experience or training as a reach truck operator.
 
• You are motivated to learn a new skill.
 
• You can travel independently to the workplace in Zeebrugge.
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.
 
• You are eager to start your career as a reach truck operator in Zeebrugge.
 
• You have a good command of Dutch or English.

Position summary:
 

You are responsible for leading the plant mechanical team (Shift Mechanical Engineers, Toolroom, Utility team, Workshop Team, Process Engineers) in all the maintenance and process activities in the plant to ensure smooth operation and maintenance of high speed can making Lines and ancillaries. You will be the key person driving operational excellence programs and size changes in the plant, and also be responsible for all the mechanical safety, lean events, capital projects, energy saving, and EIP.
 

 
 

Your responsibilities include:
 

 
 
 

• Drive the Preventive Maintenance program (periodical, monthly & daily) for the plant process equipment and auxiliaries. Communicate and implement the maintenance program with production and engineering departments’ personnel. Track Monthly compliance. 

• Daily Planning and scheduling of maintenance activities and work plan for the department. Attend morning meetings, listen to key stakeholders and plan daily activities and remedial actions. 

• Plan for shutdowns incl. securing spare parts for maintenance in advance. Execute shutdown maintenance and check effectiveness of shutdowns post startup. 

• Review the latest version of spare parts and upgrade the equipment under responsibility according with prior approval. Facilitate contact and liaison with foreign suppliers to develop all the tooling/spare parts used for Plant. Maintain Inventory of all spare parts used in plant in co-ordination with spareparts stores manager. 

• Interpret machine manuals and drawings and utilize on daily basis for maintenance planning and spareparts planning. 

• Lead the process team for process and maintenance issues. Use Lean tools such as fish bone, why-why analysis on daily basis to analyze the process and equipment issues. Liaison with Sector engineering team to overcome process issues. Communication with machine suppliers for chronic issues in machine, give required information and resolve issues on timely manner. 

• Support engineering manager in preparing budget for capital projects and maintenance expense. Execution of all plant projects from the start to completion. Identify and recommend to Manager Engineer AMCs for various equipment and services. 

• Controlling all maintenance costs within agreed budget costs and strive to meet the maintenance cost. Initiate and implement initiatives to reduce maintenance Expenses. 

• Develop, coordinate and implement actions to reduce energy consumption. 

• Lead team in operating with a high level of efficiency, integrity and enthusiasm, striving to achieve excellence in all endeavors. Provide training and support to new joiners and existing employees on various engineering functions and process.  

 
 

What are we looking for?
 

 
 
 

• 7+ years relevant experience in maintenance in high-speed manufacturing with sound maintenance management practices. 

• Experience in mechanical power presses, hydraulic equipment maintenance, printing press, handling LPG, maintenance of gas-fired ovens, boilers etc. 

• Knowledge of AutoCAD - Mechanical. 

• Experienced in TPM implementation in process industry. Good understanding of other modern lean manufacture technique - SMED, Kaizen 5S, Structured Problem Solving, Six Sigma. 

• Effective communication and problem-solving skills. 

• Ability to prioritize workload based upon the plant requirements and KPI’s. Good planning skills, coordination skill and follow-up skill 

• Comfortable communication in written and spoken English

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

 

Our Belgian SAP BI & Data team is made up of a dynamic and passionate group of individuals. With a collective experience ranging from 2 to +20 years, our colleagues have dedicated a significant portion of their careers to Capgemini, showing how much we love it here. From database migrations to data warehouses and dynamic reporting, we take it upon ourselves to maximize data-potential and empower our customers to extract the most value from their data.

 

YOUR ROLE

As a SAP Data Engineer, you'll be the brains behind the technology that powers data projects. You'll design, build, and maintain the infrastructure that allows clients to process and analyze mountains of data. Think data pipelines, ETL processes, and data warehouses. You'll ensure the data is accurate and trustworthy, collaborate with our data scientists to uncover insights, and troubleshoot systems to make sure everything runs smoothly. Plus, you'll get to work with cutting-edge tools and technologies like SAP BTP, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere and SAP Analytics Cloud. If you're passionate about solving complex problems and want to work on the forefront of data engineering, this position is for you.

 

Key tasks & activities

• You act as an experienced data engineer on data analysis, data modeling and report design projects. You engage in a diverse range of activities, including delivery planning, specification writing, data flow design, development, testing, rolling out and supporting the day-to-day functioning of analytical platforms.
• You interact with clients during workshops and trainings, forming the key link between customer requirements and technical solutions.
• You lead the implementation team, offering guidance and training to junior members while ensuring strict adherence to the project plan.
• You work closely with your project manager and the project team, but also with functional colleagues to create the best solution possible. You act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams.
• 
You provide support in proposals, product developments, and further research around Data Solutions.

 

YOUR PROFILE

• You have a minimum of 3 years of demonstrated experience in delivering (SAP) business intelligence solutions, showcasing extensive analytical skills and technical knowledge on data engineering.
• You have acquired skills within:
• Data analysis: examining large datasets to uncover patterns, trends, and insights that inform business decisions. This requires proficiency in statistical methods and the use of data analysis languages such as SQL, Python, or R.
• Data modeling: designing and implementing data structures that facilitate efficient data storage, retrieval, and analysis. This involves a deep understanding of database and data warehouse design principles, preferably implemented on SAP BW/4HANA or SAP Datasphere technology.
• Report design: using front-end design tools such as SAP BO, SAP Analytics Cloud (preferred), Tableau, or Power BI to translate complex data findings into easily understandable formats for various stakeholders.
• You possess knowledge on one or more of the main functional areas within a business, e.g., sales & distribution, purchasing, material management, financial management, and Human capital management.
• 
Fluent in Dutch/French and English.

Your Role and responsibilities
 

We are looking for an Information Security Consultant to join our Security Strategy & Advisory business unit.

 

You will be part of a diversified team with all levels of seniority. You will integrate your field of action within a more global cybersecurity approach. Therefore, you will also benefit from the experience of our 100 experts to teach you the needed skills and make your career take off.

If you want to take a role in a human centric company who put efforts in developing its collaborators, there is a place for you here. Thanks to our Cyber Academy and the support of your own Career Counsellor, Approach puts your skills’ growth at the center of its activities.

As a pure player in cyber security, we take the position of a strategical partner to help our clients securing their information, while providing our consultants many varied opportunities across the whole security roadmap.

Through this wide perspective, our Information Security Consultants advise our customers on how to improve their cybersecurity maturity and resilience. We assist our clients during the whole security journey, from assessing the current state, to proposing security improvements and managing implementation and changes.

Concretely, as an Information Security Consultant, you could:

• Provide high value services to customers in the light of Approach’s Information security offering/business:
• Perform security and risk assessment at client (e.g. perform our ACAM® (Approach Cybersecurity Assessment Methodology) to evaluate their cybersecurity maturity.
• Implemente information security management systems (ISMS), governance, risk management, based on regulations and standards.
• Be the driver of change to manage, coordinate or pilot security projects in line with the decisions.
• Propose security improvements, define priorities and create security roadmaps to follow.
• Accompany your client through the change management process.
• Develop and implement plans to anticipate, address, and mitigate the effects of various business interruptions
• Provide CISO or assistant-CISO services to our customers (i.e. provide strategic and technical advise, organizing the information security related activities, supporting customers to manage security incident(s), …)

Use your energy, your proactivity, and your smile to make our Security Strategy & Advisory business unit grow by (i.e.):

• Actively contributing to the development of tools and methodologies used by your team.
• Sharing your knowledge about topic news to your team (e.g. market needs, trends, technology evolutions that impact information security, …)
• Contributing to develop a business/commercial approach towards potential customers.
• 
Following and coaching junior colleagues.

 

Your profile
 

You have:

• A first relevant experience in Information/IT Security in a similar function
• Knowledge of regulatory and/or sector specific standards and frameworks (e.g. ISO27000, NIS2, DORA, SOC2, CIS Critical Security Controls, ...)
• Ability to understand senior management considerations (strategic level) and ability to help them in their decision.
• English and Dutch is a must have. Bilingual (FR/NL) is a plus.

Considered as a plus:

 

• Recognized Information Security certifications like ISO27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, ISO27005, EBIOS, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, COBIT, ITIL, CCSK
• Exposure to ISMS operation or implementation, cloud security projects, Third-Party risk management projects, business continuity plan (BCP) or disaster recovery plan (DRP), security assessments, security incidents, crisis management, awareness activities, …

Mindset :

 

• Willingness to provide high quality deliverables and to go the extra mile.
• True communicator with Business level communication skills: to talk and negotiate with different customers’ stakeholders at both technical and business level; to lead a security project and be able to explain it to technical and non-technical audience; to perform trainings and conduct meetings with customers’ stakeholders
• Project oriented by being dedicated to the client’s objectives and give advice.
• Teamplayer
• Manage diverse workloads and prioritize accordingly.
• Uncompromised integrity: respect for the confidentiality of both client and company information
• Ambassador for the professional values that are at the heart of our philosophy:
TOP-NOTCH
HUMAN-CENTRIC
NO-NONSENSE

jobs.occupation: Information Security Officer | IT Advisory & Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
Join an international company as an Information Security Officer specialised inISO27001, NIS2 & GDPRwithin a fast-growing international advisory environment.

We are partnering with a recognised international firm known for its expertise inIT Advisory, Cybersecurity and Governance, supporting clients in strengthening compliance, cyber risk management and security maturity.

Within this context, we are looking for anInformation Security Officerwho will play a key role in delivering high-impact projects focused on security governance, compliance frameworks and cyber risk management.
Information Security Officer - Your Role
• Develop and guide clients towards robustInformation Security frameworks
• Translate security and compliance requirements into actionable security measures
• Coordinate cyber risk assessments and security evaluations
• Define and maintainrisk managementprocesses and methodologies
• Lead security plans, awareness campaigns and training initiatives
• Support stakeholders in implementing cybersecurity controls and best practices
Information Security Officer - Your Profile
• Minimum3 years of experiencein cybersecurity, IT security or advisory environments
• Strong knowledge of frameworks such asISO27001:2022, NIS2, GDPR, COBIT, NIST, OWASP and CIS Controls
• Experience with audits, risk assessments and security governance projects
• Relevant certifications are a strong plus (ISO27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, ISO27701, etc.)
• Excellent analytical, communication and reporting skills
• Fluent in Dutch or French with professional proficiency in English

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

The Data department builds and maintains both future-ready and traditional data platforms, tools, and services to ensure easy, secure data access. It empowers data consumers with self-service capabilities while upholding governance and quality standards.

The department delivers scalable, compliant, and user-centric data solutions to meet business needs. Within this framework, the Tribe designs and implements structured, optimized data stores for APIs, reporting, and analytics. They ensure compliance, security, and governance of data assets through modern data management practices, supported by high-quality documentation and tooling. Their mission is to enable reliable, scalable, and well-governed data consumption across the organization.

At BNP Paribas Fortis, you will contribute to innovation by designing advanced data pipelines and infrastructure that power AI, real-time analytics, and strategic decision-making as part of our digital transformation. 

As a Data Engineer, you will address challenges such as scalability, latency, and compliance, ensuring secure, high-quality data flows while collaborating in Agile teams. Your work will unlock data-driven insights, combining technical excellence with regulatory requirements to shape the bank’s future.

The Tribe Data Services comprises over 160 colleagues, organized into more than 10 squads, primarily based in Brussels, with some team members working nearshore or offshore.

AND IN DETAIL

As a Functional Data Engineer, you will:

• Build and maintain optimized data stores by designing, developing, and ensuring well-structured, high-performance data assets (e.g., databases) tailored for APIs, reporting, analytics, and BI tools.
• Enable data-driven decision-making by delivering reliable, accurate, and accessible data for business intelligence, reporting, and analysis services while maintaining related infrastructure.
• Collaborate with internal clients and teams as a trusted partner, understanding stakeholder needs, guiding them on data solutions, and working cross-functionally while adhering to Tribe methodologies and standards.
• Ensure compliance and risk management by strictly following data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR) and banking security policies, mitigating risks in data collection, processing, and storage to safeguard client and institutional data.
• Drive continuous improvement by proactively identifying opportunities to enhance data quality, efficiency, and innovation—whether through new tools, automation, or process optimizations—while aligning with business and regulatory requirements.
• Collect the data from the source and design it into models that will be used by developers.  In this role you are the bridge between the business needs and the developers. You translate requests into models that will be interpreted by the developers.
• Uphold data quality and governance by implementing validation rules, monitoring, and metadata management to maintain accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
• Support stakeholders and troubleshoot issues by resolving data incidents (e.g., broken pipelines, latency problems) and partnering with analysts, product owners, or business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions—such as creating self-service datasets or optimizing queries for reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

• Education and experience:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT or engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
• Equivalent experience: minimum 3 years.
  
• Hard skills:
• Working experience with databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL.
• Knowledge of SQL, including writing complex queries and performance tuning.
• Profound Knowledge of data warehouse (DWH) modeling (e.g., Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault).
• Understanding or knowledge of ETL tools like Informatica PowerCenter.
• Understanding of Big Data technologies such as Spark, Astronomer.
• Extended knowledge of PowerDesigner tool (or equivalent)
  
• Soft skills:
• Problem-solving mindset: ability to troubleshoot complex data issues and propose scalable solutions.
• Collaboration: strong team player with experience in cross-functional Agile teams.
• Ownership and accountability: takes responsibility for data quality, delivery timelines, and system reliability.
• Communication: ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Continuous learning: stays updated on emerging data technologies.
  
• Languages:
• You communicate fluently in English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is an asset.

What you do

 
• 
You research new applications and functionality for business use cases.

 
• 
You build new processes as well as optimize existing ones.

 
• 
You rollout the template to new factories and countries.

 
• 
You work closely together with the business process owners.

In this role, you combine operational, commercial, and coordinating responsibilities within international ocean freight. You manage the full transport process from A to Z and act as the key link between internal teams and external partners. In addition, you lead a team and ensure structure, overview, and continuous process optimization.
 

The position is based in Breda, so you are willing to commute to this location on a daily basis.
 

Your Responsibilities
 
 
 
• Coordinate international deep-sea shipments (cross-trade) 
 
• Maintain contact and negotiate with shipping lines, forwarders, and suppliers 
 
• Book and follow up shipments until delivery 
 
• Manage and verify export documentation (B/Ls, L/Cs, Incoterms) 
 
• Analyze rates and optimize transport flows 
 
• Report to purchasing and sales teams 
 
• Lead and support a team (5 FTE) 
 
• Contribute to and implement improvements in operational processes 

Your Profile
 
 
 
• 3 to 5 years of experience as a freight forwarder (deep sea), ready for the next step 
 
• Strong operational and commercial mindset 
 
• Experience with international transport within a trading environment is a plus 
 
• Good command of English (required); additional languages are an asset (Dutch not required) 
 
• Proactive, assertive, and strong communicator 
 
• Able to build relationships and identify opportunities 
 
• Strong organizational skills and sense of responsibility 
 
• Flexible mindset (willing to commute to Breda; international environment with multiple time zones)

As a project coordinator you ensure that vehicles and mobility solutions meet all required regulations before entering the market. You operate in the homologation team; the heart of engineering, compliance, and coordination.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 

• Collecting, verifying, and managing technical documentation for approval.
 

• Following up on homologation planning and testing activities with internal stakeholders.
 

• Supporting vehicle testing with official authorities and ensuring correct execution.
 

• Managing certification processes, including Certificates of Conformity (CoC).
 

• Monitoring and interpreting EU and international regulations (UNECE, emissions, safety).
 

• Acting as a key point of contact for internal teams and European stakeholders.
 

• Handling administrative follow-up (documentation, SharePoint, reporting, guidelines).
 

• Improving processes around compliance tracking and data management.
 

 

You are structured, analytical, and able to create clarity in a complex and fast-moving environment.
 

• You have a Bachelor or Master in a technical field (Automotive, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering or similar).
 

• You are experienced in homologation, automotive compliance, testing, vehicle development, or technical documentation.
 

• You have a strong analytical mindset with advanced MS Office and SharePoint skills.
 

• You can organize and prioritize in an ad hoc, high-pressure environment.
 

• You take ownership and work autonomously towards deadlines, with accuracy and attention to detail.
 

• You have excellent communication skills in English, with good command of Dutch or French.
 

• You have perseverance and resilience in a demanding international context.
